extraction.name: ArtifactsBench
extraction.description: A benchmark and automated, multimodal evaluation paradigm for visual code generation that renders each artifact and captures its dynamic behavior via temporal screenshots to assess visual fidelity and interactive integrity.
extraction.creator: Tencent Hunyuan Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Candidates were aggregated from expert showcases, open datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots. Automated filters were then applied to drop incomplete, non-visual, duplicate, or non-interactive items.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Software Collection, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Expert showcases, open SVG/web-snippet datasets, web case studies, and LLM visual-to-query from screenshots.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: A two-stage filtering process was used for de-duplication and contamination control, followed by prompt rewriting by experts and LLMs for clarity, completeness, and diverse styles. Difficulty was assigned post hoc based on the aggregated performance of 30+ models.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Execution was standardized using headless Chromium (Playwright) at 1024x768 resolution with deterministic seeds. Three staged screenshots (before, during, and after interaction) were captured to summarize interaction trajectories.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each query was paired with a 10-dimension checklist covering visual, interactional, and code qualities. These checklists were drafted by an LLM and then refined by humans for specificity and screenability.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: A 10% manually curated seed was used to anchor calibration, achieving a Cohen's kappa of >= 0.8 among annotators.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Engineers with extensive front-end development experience.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The discrete sampling of screenshots may not fully capture the fluidity, correctness, and robustness of highly complex, long-horizon interactive experiences. It also does not assess an LLM's capability to function as an autonomous agent that iteratively refines artifacts.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) on their ability to generate interactive visual artifacts from multimodal instructions.

name.evidence: We introduce ArtifactsBench, a benchmark and automated, multimodal evaluation paradigm for visual code generation.

description.evidence: To bridge this gap, we introduceArtifactsBench, a benchmark and automated, multimodal evaluation paradigm for visual code generation. Our framework renders each artifact and captures its dynamic behavior via temporal (three-step) screenshots.

url.evidence: We opensource ArtifactsBench, including the benchmark, evaluation hamess, and baseline results at https://artifactsbenchmark.github.io

rai:dataCollection.evidence: We aggregate candidates from expert showcases, openSVG/web-snippetdatasets, web case studies, andLLM visual-to-queryfrom screenshots. Automated filters drop incomplete, non-visual, license-violating, duplicate, trivial, or non-interactive items, prioritizing dynamics

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: We aggregate candidates from expert showcases, openSVG/web-snippetdatasets, web case studies, andLLM visual-to-queryfrom screenshots... The curated pool seeds further expansion.

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: We aggregate candidates from expert showcases, openSVG/web-snippetdatasets, web case studies, andLLM visual-to-queryfrom screenshots.

rai:dataManipulationProtocol.evidence: Two-stage filtering: (i) MinHash + semantic similarity over prompts, checklists, and normalized DOM/CSS/JS; (ii) screenshot perceptual hashing to catch visually near-identical artifacts. Flagged items are re-authored or discarded. Prompt rewriting & difficulty calibration. Experts rewrite for clarity/completeness/executability; LLM rewriting adds diverse styles; humans verify.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: We standardize execution with headless Chromium (Playwright) at 1024×768 resolution and deterministic seeds. We capturethree staged screenshots(before/during/after scripted interaction) to summarize interaction trajectories so that dynamic feedback and state transitions are evidenced compactly.

rai:dataAnnotationProtocol.evidence: Each query is paired with a10-dimensionchecklist covering visual, interactional, and code qualities. We LLM-draft and then human-refine for specificity and screenability.

rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis.evidence: A10% manually curated seed anchors calibration and achievesCohen’s κ≥0.8 among annotators; the seed is reused as few-shot references to keep difficulty high and rubrics consistent.

rai:annotatorDemographics.evidence: We randomly selected 280 queries, along with the corresponding data from 6 models, and have them independently scored by multiple engineers with extensive front-end development experience.

rai:machineAnnotationTools.evidence: Checklists are generated by Hunyuan-Turbos and human-refined... To enhance reproducibility and robustness, we adopt a dual-referee setup: the open-source Qwen2.5-VL-72B and the proprietary Gemini-2.5-Pro.

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: Our current methodology evaluates dynamic behavior by capturing and analyzing a sequence of screenshots at fixed intervals... this discrete sampling may not fully capture the fluidity, correctness, and robustness of the entire interactive experience. ... This scope does not assess an LLM’s capability to function as an autonomousagent that can iteratively refine an artifact based on feedback

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: Therefore, we introduce ArtifactsBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on interactive visual artifacts.
